subject: Post-signature activation: phased rollout & evaluation windows for Calypso Health
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@calypsohealth.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@calypsohealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Post-signature activation: phased rollout & evaluation windows for Calypso Health

Hi Asha / Tom —

Congrats again on the signature — excited to get Calypso fully live. Per our handoff, attached is the first-draft MAP (Calypso-MAP-v1.xlsx) that embeds the implementation plan: staged rollout lanes, canary cohorts, migration windows, and training milestones. Key asks from our side to lock this week:

- Confirm two-week staging window (proposed 2026-09-13 to 2026-09-27) for feature parity tests and KV cache warmups.
- Select the primary canary cohort (suggest 3 internal pilot sites + 1 production-simulated dataset).
- Approve the migration blackout windows and agreed rollback triggers.

High-level phases (in the MAP):
1) Staging & verification — smoke tests, perf baselines, data imports (3 days per lane)
2) Canary (cohorted) — 48-hour live traffic ramp with A/B gating and automated quality checks
3) Gradual migration — 25% -> 60% -> 100% over 7 business days with step-down gates
4) Training & handover — two trainer office-hours/week + recorded sessions and knowledge transfer docs

What we’ll own: runtime deployment, canary telemetry, fallback model variants, rollback automation.
What Calypso will own: acceptance tests, access to staging datasets, ops pager for on-call during migration windows.

I attached a canary runbook template and a draft training schedule (ICS) — please review and flag anything that will conflict with your internal change freeze policies.

Next steps: if you confirm the staging dates and canary cohort by EOD Monday (2026-08-24), we’ll commit the final MAP and schedule the runbook dry-run.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com

Subject: Re: Post-signature activation: phased rollout & evaluation windows for Calypso Health

Thanks, Olga — nice summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Staging dates look OK but we have a scheduled data warehouse maintenance the week of 2026-09-20; can we shift the staging start to 2026-09-06 so our staging validation doesn't collide?
- For the canary cohort, we want one external customer segment included (non-sensitive synthetic set) in addition to your proposed internal pilot sites.
- We need explicit SLA exceptions documented for the first 72 hours of canary (our procurement team requires this for the enterprise checklist).

Also attaching our compliance checklist excerpt (we'll share the full SOC/retention docs via the security portal). Two asks for internal alignment: can you confirm who will be the SRE on-call for migrations, and can you provide an abbreviated runbook excerpt showing the automatic rollback threshold we plan to use?

Asha Patel
Director, Product Operations — Calypso Health
asha.patel@calypsohealth.com

P.S. We have legal redlines to a single paragraph in the SLA; Tom is looping legal and procurement on that thread separately.

- SRE on-call for the migration: Markus will cover the first canary window; Karthik will shadow and take over the full migration ramp.
- Automatic rollback threshold (proposal): Failure rate > 3% sustained for 15m OR P95 latency > 2.5x baseline for 10m triggers automated step-down and alert to both teams. We’ll include exact metrics in the runbook excerpt.
- Adjust staging to start 2026-09-06 as Asha requested; update MAP spreadsheet and re-issue.

Olga/Marissa — I’ll prepare the abbreviated runbook excerpt and send before EOD Tuesday so Calypso can include it in their procurement packet.

Thanks all — aligned. Summary of updates (finalizing MAP v1.1):

- Staging window: 2026-09-06 -> 2026-09-20 (two lanes, three days per lane for verification).
- Canary: start 2026-09-21, initial 48-hour ramp with external synthetic cohort included.
- Migration cadence: 25% -> 60% -> full over 7 business days with automated rollback thresholds (Failure rate >3% / sustained P95 > 2.5x baseline).
- SLA exception: Redwood provides 72-hour carveout for canary with explicit escalation play and daily sync; legal redline item acknowledged (Tom).
- Training: kick-off trainer office hours week of 2026-09-06; recorded sessions and handoff doc to be delivered by 2026-09-30.
